claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament is April 6–12.
Masters.com and the Official Masters App offer comprehensive free live coverage of all four rounds.
Masters.com and the Official Masters App coverage includes featured groups.
Masters.com and the Official Masters App coverage includes featured holes 4, 5, 6, 15, 16.
ESPN covers Thursday/Friday Rounds 1-2 from 3–7:30 p.m. ET.
CBS covers Saturday Round 3 from 3–7 p.m. ET.
CBS covers Sunday Final Round from 2–7 p.m. ET.
Paramount+ offers live simulcasts of CBS coverage.
Paramount+ offers exclusive content.
Prime Video covers early rounds from 1–3 p.m. ET.
ESPN+ offers featured groups coverage.
ESPN+ offers holes coverage.
Fubo carries ESPN and CBS.
YouTube TV carries ESPN and CBS.
DirecTV Stream carries ESPN and CBS.
Hulu+Live TV carries ESPN and CBS.
"Masters on the Range" is daily coverage available on Masters.com.
"Masters on the Range" is daily coverage available on CBS Sports Network.
"Welcome to the Masters" is pre-tournament coverage on ESPN.
Featured Feeds provide dedicated coverage for Amen Corner (Holes 11, 12, 13).
Featured Feeds provide dedicated coverage for Holes 15 & 16.
